title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Roaring Moon Wild Force 051/071 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after ROARING MOON Pokémon TCG card from the Wild Force set is a must-have addition to any serious collector's deck. With a holographic finish and a card number of 051/071, this card features the ancient and powerful Roaring Moon character in Japanese language.

The card has a standard size and is made from high-quality card stock material. It has a weak defense/toughness of Gx2 / Resist: 0 / Retreat: 2 and a cost of Vengeance Fletching (Dx2); Speed Wing (Dx1; 3). The card's attack/power includes Vengeance Fletching (70+) and Speed Wing (120). The card is illustrated by hncl and manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. Suitable for ages 6+, this card is perfect for fans of the Pokemon franchise and collectors of rare and unique cards.
